title: alsine hirta var. rubella
intro: Alsine hirta var. rubella, commonly known as red or purple sorrel, is a variant of the Alsine hirta plant, a species of flowering plant in the saxifrage family. This plant is valued for its rich nutrient profile, including high levels of vitamins A and C, potassium, and antioxidants, which contribute to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of red or purple sorrel include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions, such as digestive issues, fever, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Alsine hirta var. rubella include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
